001package io.jstach.rainbowgum.pattern.format;
002
003import java.time.Instant;
004import java.time.ZoneId;
005import java.time.ZoneOffset;
006import java.util.Locale;
007import java.util.function.Function;
008
009import org.jspecify.annotations.Nullable;
010
011import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogConfig;
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperty;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogProperties;
014import io.jstach.rainbowgum.ServiceRegistry;
015import io.jstach.rainbowgum.annotation.EnumAlias;
016import io.jstach.rainbowgum.format.AnsiSupport;
017import io.jstach.rainbowgum.spi.RainbowGumServiceProvider.Configurator;
018
019/**
020 * Pattern Config needed for pattern keywords that is generally platform specific. Through
021 * property configuration there can only be one pattern config but through programmatic
022 * configuration there is no limit by creating custom {@link PatternCompiler}.
023 * <p>
024 * This class is also a configurator for easy programmatic registration with
025 * {@link LogConfig.Builder#configurator(Configurator)}.
026 *
027 * @see PatternCompiler
028 *
029 */
030public sealed interface PatternConfig extends Configurator {
031
032        /**
033         * Formatter properties prefix
034         */
035        public static final String PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.config.{name}.";
036
037        /**
038         * Key Values that can be retrieved by various patterns.
039         */
040        public static final String PATTERN_PROPERY_PREFIX = LogProperties.ROOT_PREFIX + "pattern.property.";
041
042        /**
043         * Default zoneId if not specified.
044         * @return zone id.
045         */
046        public ZoneId zoneId();
047
048        /**
049         * Line separator for %n by default uses {@link System#lineSeparator()}.
050         * @return line separator.
051         */
052        public String lineSeparator();
053
054        /**
055         * Whether color patterns output ANSI escape codes.
056         * {@link LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode#AUTO} follows
057         * {@link LogConfig.Globals#ansiMode()}, and when that is also
058         * {@link LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode#AUTO} whether the console supports ANSI. A global
059         * {@link LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode#OFF} wins over this setting.
060         * @return ANSI mode.
061         */
062        public LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode ansi();
063
064        /**
065         * Key Value function for ad-hoc property replacements and lookup in various patterns.
066         * @return function.
067         * @see #PATTERN_PROPERY_PREFIX
068         */
069        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
070        public Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction();
071
072        /**
073         * The baseline instant used by <code>%r</code>/<code>%relative</code> to compute
074         * elapsed milliseconds. Captured once (e.g. when this config is built) rather than
075         * recomputed, the same way logback's <code>RelativeTimeConverter</code> captures its
076         * start time once when constructed.
077         * @return start time.
078         */
079        public Instant startTime();
080
081        /**
082         * The first value returned by <code>%lsn</code>. Defaults to <code>0</code>.
083         * @return sequence number start.
084         */
085        public long sequenceNumberStart();
086
087        /**
088         * Whether keywords that can cache their output (currently just
089         * <code>%logger{N}</code> via its abbreviator) actually do so. Defaults to
090         * {@link CacheType#BASIC}.
091         * @return cache type.
092         */
093        public CacheType abbreviatorCache();
094
095        /**
096         * Whether a keyword's own internal caching (currently just <code>%logger{N}</code>'s
097         * abbreviator) is used. {@link #BASIC} is the only real strategy implemented today -
098         * kept as an enum rather than a boolean so a possible future global cache toggle (the
099         * same idea already used for logger name caching and level resolvers) can reuse it
100         * without a breaking property-format change.
101         */
102        public enum CacheType {
103
104                /**
105                 * No caching - every call recomputes.
106                 */
107                @EnumAlias("false")
108                OFF,
109                /**
110                 * The default cache.
111                 */
112                @EnumAlias({ "true", "default" })
113                BASIC;
114
115                static CacheType parse(String value) {
116                        String v = value.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
117                        return switch (v) {
118                                case "TRUE", "DEFAULT" -> BASIC;
119                                case "FALSE" -> OFF;
120                                default -> LogProperty.enumValue(CacheType.class, value, "true", "default", "false");
121                        };
122                }
123
124        }
125
126        /**
127         * Creates a builder to create formatter config.
128         * @return builder.
129         * @apiNote {@link PatternConfig} implements {@link Configurator} so it can be
130         * registered at config time easily.
131         */
132        public static PatternConfigBuilder builder() {
133                return builder(LogProperties.DEFAULT_NAME);
134        }
135
136        /**
137         * Creates a builder to create formatter config.
138         * @param name for property resolution: {@value #PATTERN_CONFIG_PREFIX}.
139         * @return builder.
140         * @apiNote {@link PatternConfig} implements {@link Configurator} so it can be
141         * registered at config time easily.
142         */
143        public static PatternConfigBuilder builder(String name) {
144                return new PatternConfigBuilder(name);
145        }
146
147        /**
148         * Copies the config to builder.
149         * @param builder to receive properties.
150         * @param config to copy from.
151         * @return builder passed in.
152         */
153        public static PatternConfigBuilder copy(PatternConfigBuilder builder, PatternConfig config) {
154                builder.ansi(config.ansi());
155                builder.lineSeparator(config.lineSeparator());
156                builder.zoneId(config.zoneId());
157                builder.propertyFunction(config.propertyFunction());
158                builder.startTime(config.startTime());
159                builder.sequenceNumberStart(config.sequenceNumberStart());
160                builder.abbreviatorCache(config.abbreviatorCache());
161                return builder;
162        }
163
164        /**
165         * Default config.
166         * @return default config.
167         */
168        public static PatternConfig of() {
169                return StandardFormatterConfig.DEFAULT_FORMATTER_CONFIG;
170        }
171
172        /**
173         * Platform independent formatter config that will not change across timezones or
174         * platforms. <strong>The zoneId is UTC, line separator is LF, and ANSI is
175         * {@link LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode#OFF}.</strong>
176         * @return config.
177         */
178        public static PatternConfig ofUniversal() {
179                return StandardFormatterConfig.UNIVERSAL_FORMATTER_CONFIG;
180        }
181
182        /**
183         * Creates a property function.
184         * @param properties log properties.
185         * @param prefix prefix keys before asking LogProperties.
186         * @return function.
187         */
188        @SuppressWarnings("exports")
189        public static Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction(LogProperties properties, String prefix) {
190                record LogPropertiesPatternKeyValues(String prefix,
191                                LogProperties properties) implements Function<String, @Nullable String> {
192
193                        @Override
194                        public @Nullable String apply(String t) {
195                                String key = LogProperties.concatKey(prefix, t);
196                                return properties.valueOrNull(key);
197                        }
198
199                }
200                return new LogPropertiesPatternKeyValues(prefix, properties);
201        }
202
203        @Override
204        default boolean configure(LogConfig config, Pass pass) {
205                config.serviceRegistry().put(PatternConfig.class, ServiceRegistry.DEFAULT_SERVICE_NAME, this);
206                return true;
207        }
208
209}
210
211non-sealed interface DefaultFormatterConfig extends PatternConfig {
212
213        /**
214         * Default zoneId if not specified. If not overridden the system default will be used.
215         * @return zone id.
216         */
217        @Override
218        default ZoneId zoneId() {
219                return ZoneId.systemDefault();
220        }
221
222        /**
223         * Line separator for %n by default uses {@link System#lineSeparator()}.
224         * @return line separator.
225         */
226        @Override
227        default String lineSeparator() {
228                return System.lineSeparator();
229        }
230
231        @Override
232        default LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode ansi() {
233                return LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode.AUTO;
234        }
235
236        @Override
237        default Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction() {
238                return StandardPropertyFunction.INSTANCE;
239        }
240
241        /**
242         * Captured once when this interface is first loaded so all default configs share a
243         * single start time approximating application/logging startup.
244         */
245        @SuppressWarnings("TimeInStaticInitializer")
246        Instant DEFAULT_START_TIME = Instant.now();
247
248        @Override
249        default Instant startTime() {
250                return DEFAULT_START_TIME;
251        }
252
253        @Override
254        default long sequenceNumberStart() {
255                return 0L;
256        }
257
258        @Override
259        default CacheType abbreviatorCache() {
260                return CacheType.BASIC;
261        }
262
263        enum StandardPropertyFunction implements Function<String, @Nullable String> {
264
265                INSTANCE;
266
267                @Override
268                public @Nullable String apply(String t) {
269                        return null;
270                }
271
272        }
273
274}
275
276enum StandardFormatterConfig implements DefaultFormatterConfig {
277
278        DEFAULT_FORMATTER_CONFIG(), //
279        UNIVERSAL_FORMATTER_CONFIG {
280                @Override
281                public String lineSeparator() {
282                        return "\n";
283                }
284
285                @Override
286                public ZoneId zoneId() {
287                        return ZoneId.from(ZoneOffset.UTC);
288                }
289
290                @Override
291                public LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode ansi() {
292                        return LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode.OFF;
293                }
294
295                @Override
296                public Instant startTime() {
297                        return Instant.EPOCH;
298                }
299        };
300
301        /*
302         * For compilers built without a LogConfig, AUTO is decided by the console alone.
303         */
304        static boolean useAnsi(PatternConfig config) {
305                return switch (config.ansi()) {
306                        case ON -> true;
307                        case OFF -> false;
308                        case AUTO -> AnsiSupport.isAnsiSupported();
309                };
310        }
311
312}
313
314record SimpleFormatterConfig(ZoneId zoneId, String lineSeparator, LogConfig.Globals.AnsiMode ansi,
315                Function<String, @Nullable String> propertyFunction, Instant startTime, long sequenceNumberStart,
316                PatternConfig.CacheType abbreviatorCache) implements PatternConfig {
317
318}
